value.rationale: Structural all-group-size obstruction says state-independent fast switching cannot stabilize partial cooperation; even memoryful g2 is impossible, while g3 admits a robust stable mixture at both fixed-game marginal returns below cooperation cost. Exact if-and-only-if window supplies a meaningful boundary and basin separator in an interpretable emerging game-transition model rather than a mere numeric payoff example.
